run_smolvlm_processor: run the SmolVLMProcessor to tokenize text and process images or videos for the multimodal model
expand_text_with_image_tokens: expand text by inserting expanded image token sequences at each image token placeholder
expand_text_with_video_tokens: expand text by inserting expanded video frame tokens with timestamps at each video token placeholder
apply_chat_template_to_conversation: apply a Jinja chat template to format a list of conversation messages into a single prompt string
generate_image_prompt_string: generate a prompt string with expanded image tokens for a single or split image layout
